description: A source-backed backbone of the current operational state of fundamental physics. Core nodes are local theory-chart kernels, not claims of final truth; unresolved frontiers are explicit boundary or exterior defects.

edges.statement: Oscillation data establish mass splittings but do not close the underlying mass-generation mechanism.

notes: 13 boundary/exterior nodes are gaplike or not reachable from the core.
20 interface or cross-domain seam edges detected.

bridge.decoherence_effective_classicalit.label: Decoherence and effective classicality

regime_dimensions.description: open quantum systems with environmental coupling

bridge.decoherence_effective_classicalit.statement: Environment-induced decoherence explains stable effective classical records without by itself resolving all measurement-foundation questions.

bridge.effective_field_theory.label: Effective field theory

regime_dimensions.description: below explicit cutoff or breakdown scale

bridge.effective_field_theory.statement: Local operators and power counting encode finite-regime physics without requiring UV completion.

bridge.flrw_cosmology.label: FLRW cosmology
bridge.flrw_cosmology.statement: Homogeneous and isotropic spacetime models connect GR to expansion-history observables.

bridge.lagrangian_field_theory.label: Lagrangian field-theory bridge
bridge.lagrangian_field_theory.statement: Symmetry, fields, and action principles generate equations of motion and interaction terms.

bridge.lattice_qcd.label: Lattice QCD
bridge.lattice_qcd.statement: Numerical Euclidean-lattice calculations provide nonperturbative QCD estimates with discretization and finite-volume controls.

bridge.linear_perturbation_theory.label: Cosmological perturbation theory

regime_dimensions.description: linear and weakly nonlinear cosmological perturbations

bridge.linear_perturbation_theory.statement: Perturbation calculations connect early-universe fluctuations to CMB anisotropies and structure formation.

bridge.noether_symmetry_conservation.label: Noether symmetry-conservation bridge

regime_dimensions.description: field theories with applicable differentiable symmetries

bridge.noether_symmetry_conservation.statement: Continuous symmetries yield conserved currents in appropriate variational systems.

bridge.renormalization_group.label: Renormalization group

regime_dimensions.description: QFT and EFT regimes with controlled scale separation

bridge.renormalization_group.statement: Scale dependence and effective descriptions connect high- and low-energy charts.

core.general_relativity.label: General relativity

regime_dimensions.description: classical gravitational fields outside quantum-gravity regime

core.general_relativity.statement: Classical spacetime geometry relates curvature to stress-energy and governs gravitation in its tested regime.

core.measurement_statistics.label: Measurement statistics
core.measurement_statistics.statement: Experimental claims are mediated by likelihoods, uncertainties, systematics, and reproducibility criteria.

core.quantum_field_theory.label: Quantum field theory

regime_dimensions.description: tested collider and low-energy particle regimes

core.quantum_field_theory.statement: Relativistic quantum fields provide the operational language for particle interactions.

core.quantum_mechanics.label: Quantum mechanics

regime_dimensions.description: microscopic systems through tested quantum regimes

core.quantum_mechanics.statement: State spaces, observables, amplitudes, unitary dynamics, and measurement probabilities define the quantum formal substrate.

core.special_relativity.label: Special relativity
core.special_relativity.statement: Lorentz symmetry and invariant light speed organize high-energy and spacetime kinematics.

core.standard_model_gauge_structure.label: Standard Model gauge structure

regime_dimensions.description: tested particle physics below direct new-physics thresholds

core.standard_model_gauge_structure.statement: SU(3)c x SU(2)L x U(1)Y gauge structure organizes known nongravitational fundamental interactions.

core.statistical_mechanics.label: Statistical mechanics
core.statistical_mechanics.statement: Ensembles, entropy, coarse-graining, and thermodynamic limits bridge microphysics to macroscopic behavior.

cosmo.lambda_cdm_model.label: Base LambdaCDM model

regime_dimensions.description: large-scale cosmology with cold dark matter and cosmological constant parameterization

cosmo.lambda_cdm_model.statement: A spatially flat six-parameter LambdaCDM model summarizes the dominant current cosmological fit.

cosmo.structure_formation.label: Structure formation

regime_dimensions.description: linear plus calibrated nonlinear structure formation

cosmo.structure_formation.statement: Perturbation growth and simulations connect initial fluctuations to observed large-scale structure.

effective.chemistry.label: Chemistry from quantum many-body approximations

regime_dimensions.description: molecular and condensed chemical regimes with approximation controls

effective.chemistry.statement: Electronic structure and many-body approximations bridge QED/QM to chemical bonding and reactions.

effective.condensed_matter.label: Condensed-matter effective theories
effective.condensed_matter.statement: Many-body effective theories explain phases, quasiparticles, and collective phenomena in material systems.

effective.hydrodynamics.label: Hydrodynamics
effective.hydrodynamics.statement: Continuum fluid equations describe long-wavelength conserved densities under closure assumptions.

effective.thermodynamic_limit.label: Thermodynamic limit

regime_dimensions.description: large systems with stable macroscopic variables

effective.thermodynamic_limit.statement: Large-N limits and coarse-graining bridge reversible microdynamics to macroscopic thermodynamics.

external.bsm_frameworks.label: Beyond-Standard-Model frameworks
external.bsm_frameworks.statement: Supersymmetry, hidden sectors, axions, sterile neutrinos, modified gravity, and related frameworks remain candidate exterior charts constrained but not confirmed.

gap.baryon_asymmetry.label: Baryon asymmetry
gap.baryon_asymmetry.statement: The observed matter-antimatter asymmetry lacks a confirmed complete origin within the established Standard Model history.

gap.confinement_mass_gap.label: Confinement and Yang-Mills mass gap
gap.confinement_mass_gap.statement: Nonperturbative confinement is physically established, but a rigorous four-dimensional Yang-Mills mass-gap proof remains open.

gap.dark_energy_microphysics.label: Dark-energy microphysics

regime_dimensions.description: late-time cosmic acceleration and expansion history

gap.dark_energy_microphysics.statement: Late-time acceleration is well parameterized, but the microphysical origin and possible dynamics of dark energy remain unresolved.

gap.dark_matter_identity.label: Dark matter identity
gap.dark_matter_identity.statement: Cosmology and astrophysics require nonluminous gravitating matter, but the particle or field identity remains unknown.

gap.hierarchy_naturalness.label: Higgs hierarchy/naturalness
gap.hierarchy_naturalness.statement: The stability and naturalness of the Higgs mass remain an organizing open problem for beyond-Standard-Model physics.

gap.initial_conditions_inflation.label: Initial conditions and inflation selection
gap.initial_conditions_inflation.statement: The initial-condition problem and specific inflationary model selection remain open in early-universe cosmology.

gap.measurement_problem.label: Quantum measurement problem
gap.measurement_problem.statement: The relation between unitary quantum dynamics, definite outcomes, and interpretation remains a foundational seam.

gap.neutrino_mass_mechanism.label: Neutrino mass mechanism
gap.neutrino_mass_mechanism.statement: Neutrino masses are established phenomenologically, but the underlying Dirac/Majorana and mass-generation mechanism remains open.

gap.quantum_gravity.label: Quantum gravity

regime_dimensions.description: Planck-scale gravity, singularities, black-hole quantum regimes

gap.quantum_gravity.statement: No experimentally confirmed theory unifies quantum mechanics and dynamical spacetime at Planck-scale regimes.

obs.bao_desi_dr2.label: DESI DR2 BAO expansion history
obs.bao_desi_dr2.statement: DESI DR2 BAO measurements constrain expansion history and sharpen late-time dark-energy tests.

obs.cmb_planck_lambdacdm.label: Planck CMB LambdaCDM anchor

regime_dimensions.description: CMB anisotropy and lensing data interpreted through LambdaCDM

obs.cmb_planck_lambdacdm.statement: Planck CMB data support a six-parameter base LambdaCDM fit while constraining extensions.

obs.direct_neutrino_mass_limit.label: Direct neutrino-mass limit
obs.direct_neutrino_mass_limit.statement: KATRIN sets a model-independent direct upper bound on effective electron-neutrino mass.

obs.gravitational_wave_catalog.label: GWTC-5.0 gravitational-wave catalog
obs.gravitational_wave_catalog.statement: The LVK catalog provides strong-field GR and compact-binary population anchors.

obs.muon_g2_precision.label: Muon g-2 precision benchmark
obs.muon_g2_precision.statement: The final Fermilab Muon g-2 result is an extremely precise benchmark whose new-physics interpretation depends on theory-baseline resolution.

sm.electroweak_sector.label: Electroweak sector

regime_dimensions.description: tested electroweak energies and precision observables

sm.electroweak_sector.statement: SU(2)L x U(1)Y gauge theory describes weak and electromagnetic interactions after symmetry breaking.

sm.flavor_mixing_ckm.label: CKM flavor mixing
sm.flavor_mixing_ckm.statement: Quark flavor mixing is encoded by empirical CKM parameters.

sm.higgs_mechanism.label: Higgs mechanism

regime_dimensions.description: LHC-tested Higgs couplings and electroweak precision regime

sm.higgs_mechanism.statement: The Higgs field mechanism accounts for electroweak symmetry breaking and observed massive W/Z bosons and fermion couplings.

sm.neutrino_oscillation_pmns.label: Neutrino oscillation and PMNS mixing
sm.neutrino_oscillation_pmns.statement: Neutrino flavor oscillations require nonzero mass splittings and flavor/mass-basis mismatch.

sm.qcd_color_sector.label: QCD color sector

regime_dimensions.description: strong interactions in Standard Model regime

sm.qcd_color_sector.statement: SU(3)c gauge dynamics describes quarks and gluons.

tension.hubble_constant.label: Hubble-constant tension

regime_dimensions.description: cosmic distance ladder and CMB-inferred expansion

tension.hubble_constant.statement: Early- and late-universe inferences of H0 remain a live cosmological tension.

tension.s8_growth.label: S8/growth tension

regime_dimensions.description: large-scale structure and weak-lensing growth inference

tension.s8_growth.statement: Matter clustering amplitude comparisons create a boundary tension between probes and modeling assumptions.
